issue.title: Kibana client never retries connection-level errors: `checkRetry` treats every `*url.Error` as unrecoverable

relevant_locations.role: Configures and wraps the HTTP client with retry logic.

llm_context.input_title: Kibana client never retries connection-level errors: `checkRetry` treats every `*url.Error` as unrecoverable
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The Kibana client's custom HTTP retry logic incorrectly treats all `*url.Error` types as unrecoverable. Because Go's `net/http` package wraps every request error in `*url.Error`, transient transport errors like EOF or connection resets are mistakenly blocked from retrying.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: In `internal/retry/http.go`, the check for `*url.Error` matches unconditionally and returns `false` without checking the inner error. As a result, the subsequent fallback branches for retrying general errors and TLS-specific checks are dead code for anything returned by `http.Client.Do`.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect HTTP retry check logic
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine the `checkRetry` function within `internal/retry/http.go` to understand how `*url.Error` is currently intercepted and causes immediate return without evaluating underlying transport errors.

step_by_step_plan.title: Refine url.Error unwrapping in checkRetry
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the `*url.Error` handling in `internal/retry/http.go` so that if an error is a `*url.Error`, the underlying `Err` field is inspected. Allow transient network errors (like EOF or connection reset) wrapped inside `url.Error` to fall through to retry evaluation, while properly handling unrecoverable errors.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test for transient url.Error retries
step_by_step_plan.description: In `internal/kibana/client_test.go`, add a unit test that simulates a transient transport error wrapped in a `*url.Error` (such as an EOF during request execution) and verifies that the HTTP client retry mechanism successfully retries the request according to the policy.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run unit tests to verify fix
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the test suite focusing on the Kibana client and retry packages to ensure all tests pass successfully without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Automatic re-execution of failed HTTP requests when temporary network failures occur.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: In distributed test environments, services can occasionally drop idle connections or experience brief network blips. Retries prevent these harmless transient glitches from causing system test failures.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The custom retry policy improperly blocks retries on transient connection errors by misidentifying them as fatal URL errors.

structured_concepts.concept_name: Error Wrapping and Unwrapping in Go
structured_concepts.short_explanation: Go's idiom of wrapping low-level errors inside high-level context errors using verbs like `%w` or standard library wrappers.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Developers need to unwrap errors or use `errors.As` / `errors.Is` properly to inspect root causes rather than matching top-level wrapper types blindly.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: `http.Client.Do` wraps every error in `*url.Error`, so the retry policy must unwrap the inner error to distinguish between bad URLs and temporary network connection drops.

common_pitfalls: Treating all `*url.Error` instances as terminal without inspecting their underlying `Err` field.
Modifying unrelated HTTP clients in elasticsearch or registry packages unnecessarily.
Forgetting to add a regression test covering transient connection drops like closed server connections.
